$comment: Standalone catalog of OSM features that can name the skyline a rise/set happens behind. search/horizonFeature.ts compiles this into an Overpass query at runtime — no OSM tags are hard-coded in app code. Categories are tried in array order (first category with a hit wins); `match` entries are key=value pairs ANDed together, array entries ORed. `searchRadiusM` is how far from the ray-marched horizon point a named feature may sit and still claim it — the DEM horizon lands on a ridge line, while the named summit is often a little way along it.
